messages:
maria: Heads-up — Acme EU AP just rejected one of our invoices (ticket #4523). They say the PDF is missing the 'Registered Company Number' in the Bill‑To block and our line-item description is truncated. Can we repro and triage?
ryan: Can you paste the exact PDF text that went to them or a minimal repro?
maria: Pasted the rendered text below from the PDF we generated (sensitive bits redacted):
```
Bill To: Acme GmbH
Registered Company Number:
Address: Hauptstrasse 1, 10115 Berlin
VAT ID: DE999999999

Line items:
1x Redwood Inference - Dedicated GPU capacity for inference, monthly reserved capacity plan - €10,000.00
```
maria: Note the Registered Company Number line is blank and the line-item description looks cut off in our export. AP requires reg number present or they reject.
clara: Looks like our PDF template v2 conditionally omits the whole 'Registered Company Number' line when the field is empty. Some EU AP teams want the label + value (with fallback like "N/A") instead of dropping the line. Also template uses a hard substring on line-item desc at 80 chars.
ryan: If the reg number should be mandatory for B2B invoices, we should either populate it from legal_entities or render the label with fallback text. Do we know why legal_entities.reg_number wasn't filled for this invoice?
maria: Customer data has reg_number on file (DE12345678). They submitted purchase order with billing_entity acme_gmbh. In our DB invoice->billing_entity.reg_number exists. PDF generator produced an empty value somehow.
eng-support: I can repro locally: generate invoice id 78910 -> export pdf with template v2 -> observe blank reg line. When I inspect the template logic, it's `{{#if legal_entity.reg_number}}Registered Company Number: {{legal_entity.reg_number}}{{/if}}` and our renderer treats whitespace-only strings as falsy after our sanitation pass, so if reg_number has trailing newline or hidden char it becomes falsy. Also the line-item rendering calls `desc.substring(0,80)` before layout, which truncates without wrapping.
sam: Proposed short-term fix: change template to always render label and use `{{legal_entity.reg_number || 'N/A'}}`. For line-items switch to wrapping logic, or increase truncation to 240 and add word-boundary trim. I'll draft a PR.
clara: For rollout: create a staging job that reproduces the customer's invoice and runs their AP validation (we have a sample reject spec). Tagging @finance-bot to schedule a staging deploy and @eng-oncall for a quick patch if tests fail. :thumbsup:
finance-bot: Deployment to staging scheduled: 2026-03-18T02:15:00Z. CI artifacts: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/job/1234
maria: Customer is blocked on AP processing. They've paused payment until the PDF matches their PO formatting. Please prioritise.
ryan: I'll open an internal escalation (#ESCL-678) and attach the sample PDF, the failing AP spec, and the repro instructions. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ESCL-678
sam: Working on unit tests and a tiny template change. Expect PR by EOD with screenshots comparing old/new PDF render.
clara: After patch, run a quick compatibility check for other EU vendors — some expect the label omitted, others need it present. We'll add a feature flag if necessary.
maria: Thanks. Please post updates here so I can keep the customer informed. :pray:
